steps.body: Grids of squares show up everywhere — a chocolate bar, a window with panes, a checkerboard. Counting the grid tells you exactly how many pieces there are.

widget.prompt: A rectangle is partitioned into 4 rows and 6 columns of unit squares. How many unit squares in all?

commonCounts.feedback: That's 4 + 6. Count every square in the grid: 24.
That's just one row. Count all 4 rows: 24 in all.

widget.successFeedback: 4 rows of 6 squares each makes 24 squares in all.
widget.lowFeedback: 4 rows of 6 squares each makes 24 squares in all.
widget.highFeedback: 4 rows of 6 squares each makes 24 squares in all.

explanationVariants: 3 rows of 3 panes each is 9 panes in all.

widget.prompt: A window is divided into 3 rows and 3 columns of glass panes. How many panes are there in all?

commonCounts.feedback: That's 3 + 3. Count every pane in the window: 9.
That's just one row of panes. Count all 3 rows: 9 in all.

widget.successFeedback: 3 rows of 3 panes each makes 9 panes in all.
widget.lowFeedback: 3 rows of 3 panes each makes 9 panes in all.
widget.highFeedback: 3 rows of 3 panes each makes 9 panes in all.

steps.body: A checkerboard is a classic grid — 8 rows and 8 columns of squares, alternating colors.

widget.prompt: A checkerboard has 8 rows and 8 columns of squares. How many squares are on the whole board?

commonCounts.feedback: That's 8 + 8. Count every square on the board: 64.
That's just one row. Count all 8 rows: 64 in all.

widget.successFeedback: 8 rows of 8 squares each makes 64 squares on the whole board.
widget.lowFeedback: 8 rows of 8 squares each makes 64 squares on the whole board.
widget.highFeedback: 8 rows of 8 squares each makes 64 squares on the whole board.

steps.body: Whatever the object, the counting rule is the same: every row, every square, counted once.

widget.prompt: A garden bed is divided into 4 rows and 5 columns of planting squares. How many planting squares are there in all?

commonCounts.feedback: That's 4 + 5. Count every planting square in the bed: 20.
That's just one row. Count all 4 rows: 20 in all.

widget.successFeedback: 4 rows of 5 planting squares each makes 20 planting squares in all.
widget.lowFeedback: 4 rows of 5 planting squares each makes 20 planting squares in all.
widget.highFeedback: 4 rows of 5 planting squares each makes 20 planting squares in all.

explanationVariants: 5 rows of 4 stamps each is 20 stamps in all.

widget.prompt: A sheet of stamps is arranged in 5 rows and 4 columns. How many stamps are there on the sheet?

commonCounts.feedback: That's 5 + 4. Count every stamp on the sheet: 20.
That's just one row. Count all 5 rows: 20 in all.

widget.successFeedback: 5 rows of 4 stamps each makes 20 stamps in all.
widget.lowFeedback: 5 rows of 4 stamps each makes 20 stamps in all.
widget.highFeedback: 5 rows of 4 stamps each makes 20 stamps in all.

explanationVariants: 6 rows of 3 tiles each is 18 tiles in all.

widget.prompt: A tile floor is laid out in 6 rows and 3 columns of tiles. How many tiles cover the floor?

commonCounts.feedback: That's 6 + 3. Count every tile on the floor: 18.
That's just one row. Count all 6 rows: 18 in all.

widget.successFeedback: 6 rows of 3 tiles each makes 18 tiles in all.
widget.lowFeedback: 6 rows of 3 tiles each makes 18 tiles in all.
widget.highFeedback: 6 rows of 3 tiles each makes 18 tiles in all.

Count every tile in the mosaic: 36.

widget.prompt: A mosaic is arranged in 9 rows and 4 columns of tiles. How many tiles make up the whole mosaic?

commonCounts.feedback: That's 9 + 4. Count every tile in the mosaic: 36.
That's just one row. Count all 9 rows: 36 in all.

widget.successFeedback: 9 rows of 4 tiles each makes 36 tiles in all.
widget.lowFeedback: 9 rows of 4 tiles each makes 36 tiles in all.

hints: Count every tile across all 9 rows: 36.

steps.body: The same grid-counting idea applies to any real object split into rows and columns.
takeaways: Chocolate bars, windows, checkerboards, tiles — all grids of squares.
Count every square in every row, no matter the object.
The counting rule never changes, only the size of the grid.
